$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

CancelSupport.description: How far the remote side supports cancellation (spec 009, 3.2.4).

oneOf.description: A cancel is accepted; a stop is never confirmed.
A cancel is answered with a confirmed stop and its final charge.
Every call has an enforceable upper bound.

Disclosure.description: What a served identity is worth (spec 009, 3.7).

oneOf.description: The remote side guarantees the identity.
The remote side said so; unverified.
Nothing is known. Never replaced by a requested model or a slug.

DynamicOperation.description:
The three dynamic operations (3.2). Their names are R-05's; `rank`,
`generate` and `extract` are not dynamic operations in version 1.

DynamicOperationSupport.description: What a backend declares for one dynamic operation.

max_labels.description: The most labels or levels one request may carry.

DynamicOutputKind.description:
The output kind a request requires (3.2): `label` for any operation,
`distribution` for `proposition` and `classify`, `ordinal_distribution`
for `rubric`. A distribution is never a calibrated probability, and an
ordinal distribution is never an interval score (3.6).

HiddenState.description:
Whether output-affecting state exists that the request does not carry
(3.4). Declared `present` makes the backend ineligible for
qualification.

ServedTerms.description:
Served-identity disclosure as negotiated. `identity` is the pinned
identity, present exactly when `disclosure` is `pinned`.

TaskFamily.description: A task family and its version, selected from a host allowlist (3.2).

TemplateRef.description:
A structured template, identified by its producer (3.3, 3.4): the
versioned mapping from request fields to the provider's request, with
fixed control instructions no caller value can enter.

description:
A backend's opt-in dynamic capability, `rustev.dynamic-capability/1`
(3.4), distinct from its registered-plan descriptor: `classify` there
never implies dynamic classification here.

cost.description: The cost-bound mode; only `bounded` can be admitted (3.5).

privacy.description: Privacy options the backend accepts, by name.

task_families.description: The task families this backend answers, by name and version.

truncation.description:
The declared truncation policy. The runtime never relies on it: a
request must fit every declared limit without truncation (3.4).
